title: September 2026 Product Release
tagline: 1-Click Resume Tailoring, Sub-Second Career Copilot, and Unified Cloud Automation
headline: What is new in Career-Ops
subheadline: Instant 1-click resume tailoring, real-time Copilot guidance, parallel terminal scans, and zero-configuration cloud automation.

features.title: 1-Click AI Resume Tailor
features.summary: Paste any job link or text to generate an ATS-aligned tailored resume in under 60 seconds.
features.detail: Extracts hard technical requirements, highlights matching qualifications, and compiles clean, export-ready PDFs with zero manual setup.

features.title: Real-Time Career Copilot
features.summary: Sub-second career strategist synced to your career profile, targeting keywords, and experience.
features.detail: Refine your exit narrative, simulate technical and system design interviews, and draft personalized outreach messages without rate limits.

features.title: Parallel Discovery Terminal
features.summary: Run job discovery scans and deep document tailoring simultaneously in background sessions.
features.detail: Track multiple portals and employer pipelines in isolated parallel tabs with live streaming logs and unified status views.

features.title: Interactive Resume Studio
features.summary: WYSIWYG resume editor with live keyword alignment scoring against target job descriptions.
features.detail: Inspect ATS compliance scores, edit competency matrices on the fly, and download tailored PDFs with zero watermark.

features.title: Zero-Config Cloud Pipeline
features.summary: All background scanning, PDF compiling, and tracking pipelines run fully managed in the cloud.
features.detail: No API keys or local developer environment required. Your applications, resumes, and outreach drafts are always synchronized.
